value.rationale: The result proves two opposite oscillatory stability transitions in an unsaturated, autonomous, biologically standard two-prey–one-predator Lotka–Volterra flow as one meaningful physical conversion factor changes, retaining positive coexistence throughout. An explicit quartic, certified complete parameter phase diagram and open perturbation robustness provide a structural ecological counterexample to monotonic stability expectations, not a mere stability calculation at one arbitrary point.
